name: Ecwid
description_en:
Ecwid by Lightspeed is a hosted commerce service that can add a store to an existing website or provide a new Instant Site. Products, orders and inventory are managed centrally while supported websites and channels provide the selling surfaces.

Its plans differentiate catalogue size and operating features. Current pricing shows Starter, Venture, Business and Unlimited; old descriptions of a permanent free plan should not be assumed current. A store embedded in WordPress is still using Ecwid’s managed commerce backend.
description_zh:
Ecwid by Lightspeed 是托管电商服务，可为现有网站添加商店，也可创建 Instant Site。商品、订单和库存集中管理，受支持网站及渠道提供销售入口。

套餐按目录规模和运营功能区分。当前定价列出 Starter、Venture、Business、Unlimited，不能直接沿用旧“永久免费版”说法。嵌入 WordPress 的商店仍使用 Ecwid 托管电商后端。

core_features.explanation_zh: 在受支持网站嵌入电商，或使用 Instant Site。

core_features.explanation_zh: 当前四档卡片分别列出 10、100、2,500 及不限量商品。

core_features.explanation_en: Manage the catalogue and operations across connected selling surfaces.
core_features.explanation_zh: 跨连接的销售入口管理目录及运营。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Add a store without rebuilding the whole website
sections.title_zh: 无需重建整站即可添加商店
sections.en: A merchant with an existing content site can add Ecwid commerce, configure products, payment and shipping, and keep catalogue administration in one service. Test one product variant from the embedded page through checkout, then inspect order and stock. Embedding the storefront does not configure a payment provider or prove an external website’s custom scripts are compatible. No website was connected for this research.
sections.zh: 已有内容网站的商家可添加 Ecwid 电商，配置商品、支付和配送，并集中管理目录。可从嵌入页面选择一个规格完成结账，再核对订单和库存。嵌入店面不会自动配置支付服务商，也不能证明外站自定义脚本兼容。本文未连接网站。

sections.title_en: Map catalogue and workflow requirements to the plan
sections.title_zh: 把目录及流程需求映射至套餐
sections.en: Starter lists up to ten products, Venture up to 100, Business up to 2,500 and Unlimited no product-count cap. Business explicitly adds subscriptions, two staff accounts, wholesale groups and abandoned-cart recovery; Unlimited adds unlimited staff and POS integration scope. Marketplace connections can involve third-party apps and extra fees, and social/POS coverage has country conditions. Check the actual connector and country rather than treating the channel list as universal availability.
sections.zh: Starter 最多 10 个商品，Venture 100 个，Business 2,500 个，Unlimited 商品数量不限。Business 明确增加订阅、2 个员工账户、批发组和弃单恢复；Unlimited 增加不限量员工及 POS 集成范围。市场连接可能通过第三方应用另收费，社交／POS 覆盖也有国家条件。应按具体连接器和国家核对，不能把渠道列表当作普遍可用。

sections.title_en: Separate Ecwid’s fee policy from processor costs
sections.title_zh: 区分 Ecwid 费用与支付处理费用
sections.en: The page presents monthly and annual subscription options and zero transaction fees charged by Ecwid. The homepage says the selected payment provider processes funds, so zero Ecwid transaction fees do not imply free card processing. The extracted price table interleaves several currencies and cadence values; no single normalized payable amount is assigned here. Confirm currency, tax, billing period, apps and payment charges in the selected checkout.
sections.zh: 页面列有月付和年付，以及 Ecwid 本身每笔交易费为零。主页说明由所选支付服务商处理资金，因此 Ecwid 不收交易费，不等于银行卡处理免费。提取价格表混排多币种及付款周期，本文不填写统一应付金额；应在结算时确认币种、税、周期、应用和支付费用。

sections.title_en: Check stock and exceptions across the surfaces you use
sections.title_zh: 按实际销售入口检查库存及例外
sections.en: The inventory page documents low-stock reminders and out-of-stock options: keep an item visible, hide it, or allow preorders. It also describes minimum/maximum order quantities and mobile barcode operations. Choose the intended policy before launch, then test an exhausted variant and a cancellation. These options do not establish cross-channel reservation or retry guarantees; confirm how a connected marketplace changes stock. No inventory workflow was run.
sections.zh: 库存页列出低库存提醒及缺货处理：继续展示、隐藏或接受预订，还介绍每单最小最大数量及移动条码操作。上线前应选择预期政策，再测试规格售罄和取消订单。这些选项不能证明跨渠道预留或重试保证，需核对连接市场如何改变库存。本文未运行库存流程。

sections.title_en: Choose managed commerce for a small or growing catalogue
sections.title_zh: 适合需要托管电商的小型或成长目录
sections.en: Ecwid is relevant when the merchant wants an existing site plus managed commerce or a quick new site. A team seeking full control of backend deployment should confirm that requirement first. Source access, self-hosting, regional payment eligibility, export completeness and disaster recovery were not verified. English/Chinese editorial availability does not establish the software interface languages.
sections.zh: 希望保留既有网站并采用托管电商，或快速创建新站的商家，可评估 Ecwid。需要完全控制后端部署的团队，应先核对要求。本文未核实源码访问、自托管、地区收款资格、导出完整性及灾难恢复。英文中文介绍不代表软件界面语言。
